messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

For generations, our foundry has taken great pride in supplying our regional partners with the utmost care and quality. To continue serving you with the craftsmanship you expect from us, we must account for our rising expenses. Over the past twelve months, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost.

Taking these developments into consideration, we are pleased to present our offer for a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

We value our long-standing relationship deeply and look forward to continuing our successful cooperation.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Dear Thomas Brandlhuber,

Your labour and material cost increases deserve recognition, and the weights you supplied help explain their effect. Thank you for that transparency and your past pricing support.

By the figures you gave us - LCI-C +2.7% at 30% of your cost, PPI-C241 +6.5% at 24% of your cost - the weighted effect on the price is about +2.4%, not the 9.5% you ask for. German producer prices for electric power generation, transmission and distribution changed -3.7% from 2025-08 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-08, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).

Our options recognise rising costs while leaving room to distinguish historic margin shortfalls from current input movements. We are flexible on payment terms; please choose the package that best supports your foundry's cash planning.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 131.87 per unit, payment 30 days net, new price from 2026-11-01.
Option B: EUR 131.93 per unit, payment 45 days net, new price from 2026-11-01.

Could you share a cost breakdown for this part - material, conversion, overhead?

We value our long relationship and appreciate the support your foundry has given us.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. As to the index change data you cited, we did not know that - a fair point. We appreciate your careful review of the indices and acknowledge the recent easing in energy costs, which we have factored into our revised offer.

LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. That remains. While the weighted material and labour indices capture part of the picture, our overall operational costs require a broader adjustment than those figures alone suggest. Our costs move with LCI-C, PPI-C241, PPI-D351; the figures stay with us.

As a traditional family foundry, we treat our internal cost breakdowns as confidential, but we are pleased to offer €135.50 at 30 days payment to move towards a fair agreement. Specifically, our offer is a price of €135.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, valid from 1 November 2026. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

Dear Thomas Brandlhuber,

We recognise that input indices do not capture all your operating costs, and we respect the confidentiality of your cost breakdown. Thank you for lowering your offer and reflecting the easing in energy costs.

Your latest offer is still 7.1% above today's price of EUR 126.53.

We have raised our offer modestly and are flexible on payment terms, asking for a further price concession in return. Option B gives you the payment term you requested in exchange for a lower price; please tell us which package works best.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 133.56 per unit, payment 90 days net, new price from 2026-11-01.
Option B: EUR 133.05 per unit, payment 30 days net, new price from 2026-11-01.
Option C: EUR 133.38 per unit, payment 45 days net, new price from 2026-11-01.

We value your family's past support and hope this reciprocal step helps us reach agreement.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
